summary: Backend (14/14 pytest passed) and Frontend end-to-end tested for TCHAK. React app is fully interactive: typing reflects, auth-toggle switches register<->login, register-through-UI navigates to Home, login works, bottom nav navigates Discover/Leaderboard/Profile, vote button increments count (146->147), upload flow creates a participation and redirects to challenge page, logout returns to auth screen, language switcher opens. No console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthScreen submit button uses type='button' with onClick=submit while inside a <form onSubmit={submit}> — works but is redundant; keeping type='submit' would be cleaner and preserve native Enter-key submission semantics without double-triggering.
server.py enrich_challenge() is defined but never called; participations_count is set inline in list_challenges/featured/get_challenge. Minor DRY cleanup.
server.py list_challenges awaits count_documents in a loop per challenge — for 11 challenges fine, but consider aggregation ($lookup) for scalability.

CORS is set with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins from env defaulting to '*'; combination of '*' + credentials is not honored by browsers. Since app uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), credentials=True is unnecessary — set it to False or supply explicit origins.
Media endpoint /api/media/{file_id} returns raw bytes but sets no Cache-Control; consider adding cache headers for performance.
public_user() leaks 'email' field for all users (e.g. via /api/users/{username} and leaderboard creators). Email should not be exposed publicly.
test_credentials: test@tchak.ht / test123 (existing); demo users password: tchak123
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed users and one TEST_ participation via UI/API tests. No cleanup performed (safe, prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 pytest cases pass. Frontend interactivity previously suspected broken has been definitively verified working (typing, toggle, submit, navigation, voting, upload, logout all functional). Main concerns for future iterations: public_user leaks email; CORS allow_credentials=True with wildcard origins; potentially expose email selectively.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Earlier manual screenshot confusion was likely due to screenshot tool renavigating and losing state; real interactive test confirms React state updates propagate correctly.
